stage_a_raw:
{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "disjunctive_pair_orientation",
      "evidence": "\"The order in which operations are scheduled on a shared machine is determined by binary decision variables, which take a value of 1 if one operation is scheduled before another and 0 otherwise.\"",
      "options": [
        "one binary y[a,b] per unordered pair with both big-M directions (y=1 means a before b, y=0 means b before a)",
        "one binary y[a,b] per ordered pair with a single big-M direction per ordered pair",
        "one binary y[a,b] per ordered pair with both big-M directions (redundant but consistent)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.25,
        0.15
      ],
      "majority_option": "one binary y[a,b] per ordered pair with a single big-M direction per ordered pair"
    },
    {
      "decision": "big_M_value",
      "evidence": "\"A large constant of 100,000 is used to enforce that operations on the same machine do not overlap in time.\"",
      "options": [
        "M = 100000 as stated",
        "M = sum of all processing times (tight big-M)",
        "M = number of operations (tight big-M)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "M = 100000 as stated"
    },
    {
      "decision": "makespan_constraint_direction",
      "evidence": "\"The makespan must be at least as large as the completion time of every operation\"",
      "options": [
        "Cmax >= s[j,o] + p for all operations",
        "Cmax = max over operations of (s[j,o] + p)",
        "Cmax >= s[j,o] for all operations (start times only)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.07,
        0.03
      ],
      "majority_option": "Cmax >= s[j,o] + p for all operations"
    },
    {
      "decision": "start_time_domain",
      "evidence": "\"Start times for all operations must be non-negative\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.7,
        0.25,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "precedence_constraint_form",
      "evidence": "\"operation 0 must be completed before operation 1 can begin\"",
      "options": [
        "s[j,1] >= s[j,0] + p (strict completion before start)",
        "s[j,1] >= s[j,0] + p with equality allowed (same as above)",
        "s[j,1] > s[j,0] + p (strict inequality)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.08,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "s[j,1] >= s[j,0] + p (strict completion before start)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_definition",
      "evidence": "\"minimize the total production time, or makespan\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize Cmax",
        "minimize sum of completion times",
        "minimize sum of start times"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.03,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize Cmax"
    }
  ]
}
